key_insights: Kronos model is 48.8% directionally accurate — slightly below random (50%)
Strong bearish predictions are the most reliable at 56.1% accuracy
Bullish and neutral predictions are unreliable (44-49%)
Antitrend (all 3 variants) is a LOSING strategy over 599 windows — contradicts earlier small-sample backtest
Trend-following strategies (trend_momentum, momentum_slope, range_extension) are consistently profitable at +7-9% over 2 weeks
Range extension has the best risk-adjusted profile: good PnL with fewer trades
The current system's antitrend focus is wrong — should pivot to trend-following / range-extension
